entry.summary: Matt Frost, QSM, is a Principal Advisor in Whaikaha – the first Ministry of Disabled People in the world. He was previously at the Ministry of Education as a Principal Advisor: Lived Experience. On human rights for disabled people, Matt has represented Aotearoa New Zealand at the UN in New York. His longstanding advocacy has included chairing the Implementation Advisory Group for the New Zealand Autism Spectrum Disorder Guideline and serving as Deputy Chair of the Living Guideline Group.
